name: Wedgewood Hotel and Spa
insider_take: This intimate Relais & Châteaux gem sits in the heart of downtown Vancouver, where European elegance meets West Coast sophistication in a boutique setting that feels more like a private residence than a hotel.
whats_special: The Wedgewood is Vancouver's only independently-owned luxury boutique hotel, featuring a rooftop garden that supplies fresh herbs to its award-winning restaurant. As one of only 580 Relais & Châteaux properties worldwide, it maintains the exclusivity of a private club while offering personalized service that includes remembering guests' preferences from previous stays.
pro_tip: Request a Penthouse Suite for exclusive access to the private rooftop terrace with panoramic views of the North Shore mountains – it's Vancouver's best-kept secret for intimate celebrations.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature Afternoon Tea service featuring locally-sourced ingredients, and the proximity to Robson Street's luxury shopping district. You're also just steps away from the Vancouver Art Gallery and a 5-minute walk to the scenic Coal Harbour waterfront.
pros: Boutique luxury hotel with intimate European-style elegance
Prime downtown Vancouver location near shopping and attractions
Personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Limited room inventory due to boutique size
